description: Classifies mentions of the previous workspace version that remain after prepare_release_version_bump.ps1. The first rule whose glob matches a tracked path wins. Unmatched mentions are reported as unclassified.

rules.note: Generated or locked files. Run the next_steps commands after -Apply.
Prose that names the current release. Update by hand when the release is prepared.
Supported release line. Change only when the release policy says the new line is current.

Compatibility baseline: the last version published on crates.io (baseline_ref and baseline_commit in scripts/candidate_api_baseline.mjs). Update after the new version is published, not at bump time. api-stable-candidate-baseline.json itself is regenerated at bump time: its product_version follows the inventory.
Statements about the previous line itself (changelog history, known issues, compatibility and downgrade notes). Do not change.

next_steps: node scripts/candidate_api_baseline.mjs --write (after the inventories; only product_version should change, otherwise stop for SemVer and migration review), then --check

for each tests/compile/*/ and macros/tests/compile/*/ fixture: cargo update --offline --manifest-path <fixture>/Cargo.toml -p <each ranvier-* package that has no source line in that Cargo.lock> (only those version lines change; then node scripts/candidate_compile_contract.mjs)
review release_docs and release_line mentions; leave historical and published_baseline as they are
